description:
Recruit Laicaille Administrator
  
(For Starsector 0.98-RC8)

Description

A small mod that adds dialogue choices to the administrator of the Laicaille Habitat after they're dismissed, to allow you to recruit them yourself. I felt a bit guilty that I'd got them fired, so figured it'd be interesting to offer them a new job.

As they prioritise their colonists over wider political concerns, the colony they manage gains a +1 bonus to stability, but takes a -20% penalty to income generated. However, whilst assigned to a colony they increase your maximum administrators by 1; effectively being 'free'.  When first recruited, you gain a temporary +1 administrator bonus so you can assign them.

Installation

Download via the link or going to GitHub and getting the latest

.zip

from the Releases list, extract the

starsector-recruit-laicaille

directory, and place it in your starsector/mods directory then check it in the launcher.

Credits

Thanks to Jaydee for the code for displaying character skills.

Thanks to DukeOfEarl for fixing the skill being added to random admins.

Misc

God Laicaille is hard to spell.
